gates: capacity market 07:30 the day before; energy bids 45 minutes before each quarter; day-ahead order before 12:00 the day before
rule: Hold mFRR capacity, up direction, in every hour the store can cover two quarters at full power; bid it at zero and take the marginal price (gate 07:30 the day before).

In every quarter of a held hour, bid the obligated energy at the day-ahead price plus 5 EUR/MWh (gate 45 minutes before the quarter). Under marginal pricing you are then activated whenever the zone regulates up at all, and paid the clearing price.

Refill with a price-conditional day-ahead order for tomorrow: buy 0.25 MWh in any quarter that clears at or below the 20th percentile of the previous seven days' quarter prices - and by down-regulation when not holding, where you are paid to charge.
Nothing else: no direction forecasting, no spike hunting, no deliberate imbalance.
rules: battery brief: a fixed rule applied to the published day-ahead prices of the delivery day; not a forecast; released at once
